versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_11001 If <FunctionIndex> is a defined function index, CallTrustedFunction shall call the function <FunctionIndex> out of a list of implementation specific trusted functions with the protection settings of the OS-Application which provides the trusted function AND shall return E_OK after completion.
